evals.prompt: hey can you add the anthropics quickstarts repo to my knowledge base? I want to search through their examples later
evals.expected_output: Should invoke kb_add_repo with repo_url='anthropics/anthropic-quickstarts', branch='main', and confirm the repo was added to indexing queue

assertions.text: Confirmed to user that repo was added to indexing queue
Did not create any unnecessary files or scripts

evals.prompt: search my docs for information about customer support chatbots using Claude API
evals.expected_output: Should invoke kb_search with appropriate query about Claude API customer support, return ranked results with sources and snippets

assertions.text: Search query includes relevant keywords (customer support, chatbot, Claude API)
Presented search results with source, file path, and text snippets
Results are ranked by relevance score

evals.prompt: what's in my knowledge base right now? give me a summary
evals.expected_output: Should invoke kb_status and present the statistics in a readable format (sources count, documents, chunks, storage location)

assertions.text: Presented information in readable format (not raw JSON)
